scope: 26 confirmed monsters from the 43 missing-loot names; local snapshot update only

rules.unknownRates: Unspecified and <0.00% source rates become null, never zero.
rules.recipes: Append (recipe) to the recorded base item name; keep its verified base wiki link.
rules.gemVariants: Keep +3 INT and +3 SPR as separate labelled drops, each with its recorded chance.
rules.links: Add only item page titles resolved through the public wiki API.
rules.images: Reuse existing item image metadata; do not invent thumbnail paths.
rules.existingData: Existing monster drops and all map/marker coordinates are preserved.
